branding.tagline: Live, validated Xero reports that refresh each time you open them.

description: Live Xero reports for your Reports library, including profit and loss, balance sheet, trial balance, general ledger, aged receivables and payables, cash flow, GST, budget variance, bank reconciliation, dashboards and month-end report packs. Each report reads your connected Xero organisation every time it opens, checks its own figures and shows the result. You can download it as PDF or Excel, or share it. Find the reports in Reports, under From your plugins. Read-only in Xero.
name: xero-reporting-studio
